independentImplementations: R4-owned JPEG marker parser for APP2 ICC_PROFILE sequence assembly
R4-owned HEIF parser resolving pitm primary item through iprp/ipco/ipma to colr properties
libheif 1.23.2 heif-convert default primary-image decoder for HEIF grid primary items

renderComparison.unprofiledSourceRule: No explicit image-output color interpretation profile is present. The independent parser blocks exact XMP interpretation fields (ColorSpace, ColorPrimaries/Primaries, TransferCharacteristics/TransferFunction, MatrixCoefficients, Gamma, WhitePoint/Chromaticities, ICC/Output/ColorProfile, ColorMode, ColorEncoding, ColorRenderingIntent), ICC APP2, calibrated EXIF ColorSpace, extended XMP, or ExifTool color profile tags. Adobe CameraRaw development/history fields such as ColorGrade, ColorNoiseReduction, CameraProfile, ProfileName, and LensProfile are separately reported as processing metadata and are not treated as the JPEG's current display color profile.
renderComparison.decoder: JPEG uses FFmpeg 8.0.1 CLI to decode exactly one selected stream/frame to RGB24 rawvideo. HEIF primary uses libheif 1.23.2 heif-convert default primary-image decode to PNG; the R4-owned HEIF parser independently resolves pitm/item properties, and decoded dimensions plus ICC bytes must equal that exact primary. Neither decoder applies ICC CMS; codec YCbCr-to-RGB is the only decoder color conversion. Do not insert colorspace/zscale/tonemap filters.
renderComparison.streamSelection: JPEG must expose exactly one image/video stream in FFprobe. HEIF decode uses libheif's primary-image API path; no first-thumbnail fallback. Independently parsed pitm item type/dimensions/ICC must agree with the decoded default-primary PNG. FFprobe streams are only selected for a supplemental decode when AVStream.id equals pitm item_ID; absent match never authorizes selecting another stream.
renderComparison.colorManagement: After FFmpeg decode, apply the exact independently extracted source ICC bytes exactly once using Pillow 12.1.1 ImageCms/LittleCMS 2.17 profileToProfile to an explicit Pillow sRGB destination profile, RGB-to-RGB, relative-colorimetric intent, black-point compensation off. Never apply a second CMS operation.
renderComparison.orientation: No orientation transform is applied. JPEG must have no EXIF Orientation or IFD0 Orientation=1. HEIF primary must have no associated irot/imir property and ExifTool must report Orientation absent or Horizontal (normal); disagreement or non-identity blocks the route. FFmpeg uses -noautorotate.
renderComparison.alignment: Require the independent JPEG/HEIF primary dimensions and both FFprobe decoded dimensions to agree exactly before color management; source and output dimensions must match. No crop, translation, rotation, or resampling is permitted before comparison.
renderComparison.resize: After the single ICC-to-sRGB conversion, resize both RGB images with Pillow Image.Resampling.LANCZOS to the same dimensions using scale=min(1,1024/max(width,height)); dimensions are round(original_dimension*scale) and each long edge is at most 1024. No other resize or alignment step.
renderComparison.metric: CIEDE2000 in Lab after LittleCMS conversion to sRGB
renderComparison.thresholdStatus: frozen-before-formal-conversion; must not be adjusted after observing route outputs

negativeTests.reason: The existing public request has no target-profile intent; this unsupported-request assertion makes no sample preservation or colorimetric claim.
Malformed/duplicate/shadow color associations are exercised as explicit adversarial fixtures, not presented as RealSample conversion routes or as evidence for any positive route.

renderPipeline.primaryStreamRule: JPEG must have one FFprobe stream. HEIF primary item is decoded by libheif 1.23.2 heif-convert default primary-image path; independently parsed pitm/item type, dimensions, ICC association and decoded PNG dimensions/profile must agree. FFprobe AVStream.id equality is required only for supplemental FFmpeg primary decode; no ordinal fallback.
renderPipeline.frameRule: Decode exactly frame 0 from that stream with -frames:v 1.
renderPipeline.iccRule: FFmpeg JPEG decode or libheif HEIF primary decode produces RGB code values without ICC CMS; Pillow only reads PNG RGB bytes; LittleCMS applies source ICC once after decode.
renderPipeline.orientationRule: Identity only, established from JPEG EXIF/HEIF transforms and cross-checked with ExifTool; -noautorotate; any disagreement blocks.
renderPipeline.alignmentRule: Exact width/height equality required before CMS; no crop/registration; one specified Lanczos resize after CMS only.
